scenes.headline: How to unzip without room for both
scenes.sub: Extract from the end, and cut the archive behind you.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Scupper! Unzip needs room for the archive and every file at once. This tool only needs room for the files.

scenes.text: A zip keeps its index at the end and compresses each entry alone, so you can extract the last entries and truncate the file behind them.
scenes.say: A zip compresses each entry alone and keeps its index at the end. So extract the last entries, then shorten the file.

scenes.title: One batch, in a fixed order

steps.say: Before anything is cut, the index at the end of the archive is copied to a small side file.
Then it takes entries from the end, as many as fit in the free space, and extracts them in parallel.
Once the files are flushed to disk, the journal records how long the archive should now be.
Only then is the archive truncated. The space it gives back pays for the next batch.

scenes.title: One big file that will not fit

left.title: Truncate from the end
items: Frees an entry only when done
left.say: Truncation works everywhere, but it frees an entry only once all of it is out.

right.title: Punch a hole
items: Frees the start of a big file
right.say: For a file bigger than the free space, it punches holes behind each flushed step instead.

scenes.title: The archive shrinks as the folder grows

steps.say: In the project's animation, the archive loses blocks from its end.
The disk never has to hold both at full size.

items.say: The archive is only ever cut back to the last commit.
Running it again redoes one batch and finishes.
Or restore turns what is left back into a normal zip.

scenes.title: Same archive, nearly full disk
scenes.note: peak disk used; unzip stopped at entry 34 of 47
scenes.say: On a disk too small for unzip, it ran the disk nearly full and finished, every file intact.

scenes.text: On a roomy disk it peaks like unzip. On a tight one, each batch shrinks to fit the freed space.

recap: Extract from the end, then truncate
Holes for files that will not fit
scenes.say: Extract from the end, journal before every cut, and punch holes for the files that will not fit.
